text.en:
For the purposes of the survey, classification and demarcation of the public lands and of the
forest zones thereon, there are hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the following sums, which shall be added to the appropriations made in section one , subsections
GG and HH, of Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and seventy-five:
(See table of ACTS No. 2906 in PUBLIC LAWS PHILIPPINE LEGISLATURE VOLUME 15 Page 242 to

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 23,1920.
